attchmntText: Sree Rayalaseema Hi-Strength Hypo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sree Rayalaseema Hi-Strength Hypo Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 45,735.78 lakhs. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 5,830.61 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 33.97. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were Rs. 46,870.52 lakhs. The company has no borrowings. The financial results were reviewed by the audit committee and approved by the Board. Limited review reports are attached.

attchmntText: Sree Rayalaseema Hi-Strength Hypo Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of report on relodgement of transfer requests of physical shares'.
voiceSummary: Sree Rayalaseema Hi-Strength Hypo Limited submitted a report to BSE and NSE regarding the re-lodgment of physical share transfer requests under the special window mandated by SEBI Circular dated January 30, 2026. The report covers the status as of October 2026. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, M/s. Aarthi Consultants Private Limited, confirmed that zero requests were received, processed, approved, or rejected during the month. The average time taken for processing is also reported as zero. The company has filed this intimation with the stock exchanges for their information and record.
